author: Confident_Ad_8094
body:
Thank you for sharing your story, I started taking lisinopril in April. Began with 10mg and two weeks later moved up to 20 mg, that’s when the light headedness began. I emailed my dr today & told her that I was lowering the dosage to 10mg tomorrow and I would be quitting this medication; I don’t see the point in taking a medication that makes me feel worse rather than better. 
I made this decision after experiencing more light headedness after taking the medication this morning and then googling the side effects. 

I’m not looking forward to having to go through withdrawals but I’m hoping it won’t be too bad since I’ve only been on this medication since April. 

This really angers me that we are told to take this, we trust our dr’s judgement and then we have problems.
